what: Letter cards enter one at a time from outside the bottom left of the screen (top 120%, left −50%) tilted 10° and stand straight in the center (1 beat), stay there (2 beats), then fly off tilting 10° again to outside the top right (top −50%, left 120%) (1 beat). One card takes 4 beats, and the next card follows the same path after the previous one has fully left. Tied to the whole section’s scroll (scrub, no curve), so rewinding plays it in reverse

options.tilt: Tilt angle on enter and exit (deg), default 10 · 0 keeps it straight
options.hold: Beats held at the center, default 2
options.per: Screens used per card, default 2.17 — three cards in the original 600dvh section (start top 50%)

use:
Letter 1
Letter 2
— Card width comes from the user-side CSS (original 70%, max 720px)

from.note: The original applies top and left keyframes to the pinned card. The part moves to the same % position inside the sticky stage
